translationRepairs: Because in the commandery he had spent 360,000 in court lodging funds to provision the two palaces' princes and to make crimson jackets as a military offering, he was demoted to grand master for splendid virtue; soon after he was given the added titles grand minister of ceremonies and golden battle-axe with purple trim, and additional gentleman attendant-in-chief.

Because in the commandery he had spent 360,000 in court lodging funds to provision the two palaces' princes and to make crimson jackets as a military offering, he was demoted to grand master for splendid virtue; soon after he was given the added titles grand minister of ceremonies and golden seal with purple ribbon, and additional gentleman attendant-in-chief.
金紫 abbreviates 金印紫綬 (golden seal and purple ribbon); “golden battle-axe with purple trim” invents a 斧 reading unsupported by 尋加太常及金紫.

Because while in the commandery he had used 360,000 of the court lodging funds to provision the two palaces' princes and to make crimson jackets as a military offering, he was demoted to grand master for splendid virtue; soon after he was given the added titles grand minister of ceremonies and golden battle-axe with purple trim, and additional gentleman attendant-in-chief.
